dog.description_text:
Meet Fern, a 2 year old, 15 pound, wonderful Chi mix. Fern is very shy and would do best with a patient owner outside of the city who will help her build her confidence.

If you would like to adopt this dog, please visit www.pupstarzrescue.org for an application!
